from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetric(BaseModel):
    """Financial metrics extracted from a single 10-Q filing for ratio calculation."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    total_revenues: str | None = Field(description="Total revenues/Sales reported for the period")
    revenues_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of revenues (dollars, thousands, millions)")
    beginning_cash: str | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents balance at period start")
    ending_cash: str | None = Field(description="Cash and cash equivalents balance at period end")
    net_cash_change: str | None = Field(description="Net change in cash and cash equivalents for the period")
    cash_unit: str | None = Field(description="Unit of cash values (dollars, thousands, millions)")
    period: str | None = Field(description="Reporting period covered by the filing")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetric]
